edit.description: the standard, spec layout and procedure skill shapes
each pattern hydrates with consumer fields

summary: The starter adds the opt-in patterns: a standard over rule and a spec layout holding invariants (statement, holder), and a procedure skill with topics, each typed over the consumer's fields
acceptance: each pattern constructor takes the consumer's names, prose, paths and a field type parameter, carries only temper's concepts as its own fields, and emits; pnpm --dir sdk test green
notes: SDK-only behavior: the SDK gate holds it. Build on kind<T>(), extend() and the layout surface; no vocabulary of the consumer's inside a pattern.
